An analogue of Friedgut’s theorem for convex influences? As noted earlier, in the full version of this paper, we establish a Gaussian space analogue of a consequence of Friedgut’s Junta Theorem [24] for Boolean functions over {±1}n . The following would give a full-fledged Gaussian space analogue of Friedgut’s Junta Theorem: ▶ Conjecture 1 (Friedgut’s Junta Theorem for convex influences).
